ChildCreate.title: ChildCreate

on this device (``adopt_guest`` is that guest's access token) or making a new account.

from the child's own eligibility, and whether the link still works.

PAY-17: a parent buys Pro for one child's account (individual plans only; a family plan is
the parent's own and adds the child as a member instead).

Exchanged once, within ``expires_in`` seconds, with supabase-js
``verifyOtp({ token_hash, type: 'email' })`` (locally ``POST /v1/dev/auth/verify-otp``).

ConsentRequestStatus.description: The teen's poll while AUTH-21 is open (every 5 s), and AUTH-23's data.

ContentReportIn.title: ContentReportIn
ContentReportIn.description: SET-24 Report content: one sheet for lesson, question, AI and community content (R39).

ContextOut.title: ContextOut
ContextOut.description: What the tutor can see, for the context chip (tutor-social §A5 step 1).

question.title: Question
question.description: The question without its key; shown once started

tz.title: Tz
tz.description: IANA zone of the device, for the streak day (R23)

beat_pct.title: Beat Pct
beat_pct.description: Share of players beaten, when ranks are shown

DeckCopy.title: DeckCopy
DeckCopy.description: The copy belongs to the student (``source = 'shared_copy'``); the device stores it.

link.title: Link
link.description: Link Google to the guest in the Authorization header

DevSession.title: DevSession
DevSession.description: The shape of Supabase's token endpoint (docs/contracts/sync.md "Dev auth").

DoubtPhotoOut.title: DoubtPhotoOut
DoubtPhotoOut.description:
AI-18: what the vision model read from the photo, for the student to check or edit.
``reason`` says why nothing usable was read (the app shows Retake).

DoubtSolve.title: DoubtSolve
DoubtSolve.description:
AI-19: solve the confirmed question as a tutor chat (SSE, the tutor's events). ``text`` is
the student's message (the confirmed question or a chip); ``question_text`` saves an edit
from AI-18 first; ``reveal`` is "Show full solution" (hints first until then).

DuelAnswerIn.title: DuelAnswerIn
DuelAnswerIn.description:
One answer to the open question; the server times it from the question's opening.
Re-sending the same question returns the first answer's result (idempotent by question).

DuelCreate.title: DuelCreate
DuelCreate.description: A friend duel (``opponent_id``) or a labelled solo round (``solo``), never both.

EventContext.title: EventContext
EventContext.description:
The client's common props (packages/analytics ``CommonContext``). Anything else is dropped.
``is_guest`` and the audience come from the session and profile, never from here.

FamilyOut.title: FamilyOut
FamilyOut.description:
The payer's view: seats (people besides the payer), members and open invites. A member
sees ``role = member`` and the seat counts only.

follow_up_of.title: Follow Up Of
follow_up_of.description: The score this answers a follow-up question of

FeynmanOut.title: FeynmanOut
FeynmanOut.description:
AI-11: three meters (0-100), the key points with their status, follow-ups, and the last
score for this concept when one exists (never a made-up comparison).

Gate.title: Gate
Gate.description: SOC-02 decides what to show from ``state``; ``features`` lists what this student may use.

GenerateMock.title: GenerateMock
GenerateMock.description: MOCK-26 custom weak-area mock (Pro) or a timed chapter mock (counts as sectional, Q15).

GuardianLinkRequestOut.title: GuardianLinkRequestOut
GuardianLinkRequestOut.description: The guardian's own list (SET-18). The teen's name shows only after the teen accepts.

eligible.title: Eligible
eligible.description: null for a guest: only the hint is known until sign-in (auth flow §8)

name.title: Name
name.description: Adults: display name. Minors: auto nickname (R31)

LinkAccept.title: LinkAccept
LinkAccept.description: The teen's confirmation, kept as the request's evidence (no free text).

LinkRequestCreate.title: LinkRequestCreate
LinkRequestCreate.description:
SET-18 path 2. At most one of ``teen_email`` (the teen's sign-in email) and ``teen_code``
(the teen's invite code, as on their friend QR); with neither, the teen claims the returned
code. The answer never says whether an account matched.

name.title: Name
name.description: Adults: display name. Minors: auto nickname (R31)

full_duration_until.title: Full Duration Until
full_duration_until.description: Start by this time for the full duration; later starts end at window_end

events_url.title: Events Url
events_url.description: Server-Sent Events fallback for the same events

LiveRoom.title: LiveRoom
LiveRoom.description: MOCK-03. Times are the server's; ``server_time`` gives the client its clock offset.

manifest.title: Manifest
manifest.description: The manifest body, inlined in local mode when the file is on disk

MarkingOut.title: MarkingOut
MarkingOut.description: A blueprint marking rule for one question type (skills/exam-blueprint).

Me.title: Me
Me.description: SOC-03: the student's own handle, nickname and privacy.

MistakesCard.title: MistakesCard
MistakesCard.description: The student's own tags. Shown once anything is tagged.

MockAccess.title: MockAccess
MockAccess.description:
app-core ``mockAccess``. A locked mock names the paywall source; the client opens PAY-01 only
on a tap (practice §4.1).

MockDetail.title: MockDetail
MockDetail.description: MOCK-02: everything the blueprint says, never a fallback value (practice §9.1).

MyLimits.title: MyLimits
MyLimits.description: What the child's device caches to enforce SET-16 offline and to show SET-19.

Name.title: Name
Name.description:
How a person is shown to the viewer (R31 amended): adults by display name; minors by the
auto nickname, or by the pet name to friends added by invite link or QR.

Overview.title: Overview
Overview.description: SOC-01 in one call; when locked, SOC-02 still shows the student's own numbers.

ParentFriend.title: ParentFriend
ParentFriend.description: A friend as the child sees them (B13: the parent sees and can remove friends).

PropIssue.title: PropIssue
PropIssue.description: A prop that was removed: its name and why (never its value).

title_key.title: Title Key
title_key.description: packages/i18n ME-20 template key; takes {n} = target

QuotaOut.title: QuotaOut
QuotaOut.description: A free-tier counter (app-core ``Quota``). ``remaining`` is null when unlimited.

url.title: Url
url.description: Signed, short-lived link to the audio

ReadinessCard.title: ReadinessCard
ReadinessCard.description: Ignores the period (a current state). Not a predicted score (PRD §6.3).

reminder_at.title: Reminder At
reminder_at.description: When the mock_reminder push is due (the room opening)

ReportIn.title: ReportIn
ReportIn.description: SOC-23. The note goes to the moderation team only, and only from adults (B11).

queued.title: Queued
queued.description: Cards started or moved into today's (or tomorrow's) queue

bundle_ref.title: Bundle Ref
bundle_ref.description: Bundle that holds the question for offline use

source.title: Source
source.description: estimate or fixed (a teen's own time)

SleepReviewOut.title: SleepReviewOut
SleepReviewOut.description: Tonight's sleep review for the app to schedule as a local notification.

SpeedCard.title: SpeedCard
SpeedCard.description:
Answers to questions with an ``ideal_time_s``. Slow means over the ideal time, fast means
under it.

Standing.title: Standing
Standing.description: R26: percentile and rank only from real first attempts, above the owner's threshold.

tz.title: Tz
tz.description: IANA zone of the device when the event happened; places it on the local day

SyncStateResponse.title: SyncStateResponse
SyncStateResponse.description: Sections that did not change since ``since`` are omitted.

TeenLinkRequestOut.title: TeenLinkRequestOut

result.title: Result
result.description: Send back to Gemini Live as the function response

VoiceQuota.description:

can't start for this student right now.

client_session_id.title: Client Session Id
client_session_id.description: Client UUID; asking again with the same id mints a fresh token (reconnect)

token.title: Token
token.description: Single-use Gemini Live token; never stored by the server

model.title: Model
model.description: From GEMINI_LIVE_MODEL (config), for the client's connect call

max_seconds.title: Max Seconds
max_seconds.description: This session ends at this many seconds of talk

warn_at_seconds.title: Warn At Seconds
warn_at_seconds.description: Show the 'about 2 minutes left' banner here

safety.title: Safety
safety.description: Present when the transcript showed a crisis signal

needs_more_answers.title: Needs More Answers
needs_more_answers.description: Answers still needed before weak spots can be found; null when enough

unset_thresholds.title: Unset Thresholds
unset_thresholds.description: Owner flags not set yet; their rules are skipped (practice §9.2)

WeekReport.title: WeekReport
WeekReport.description: SET-15. Counts and topic names only (never chat text, notes or anything typed).

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Client UUIDv7; a repeat returns the same session

``chapter_id``, ``question_ids`` or ``paper_id``; or none for a mixed drill of the exam.
